rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice for a paper napkin at a meal, although it can also mean a general tissue.

example.english: After eating, grab a napkin and wipe your mouth.
example.traditional: 食完嘢攞張紙巾抹下嘴啦。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 je5 lo2 zoeng1 zi2 gan1 mut3 haa5 zeoi2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a table napkin as a dining item, especially when distinguishing it from a general tissue.

example.english: Western restaurants put a table napkin beside the cutlery.
example.traditional: 西餐廳會喺餐具旁邊放餐巾。
example.jyutping: sai1 caan1 teng1 wui5 hai2 caan1 geoi6 pong4 bin1 fong3 caan1 gan1
